title: Reset a forgotten password
question: How do I reset a forgotten password?
answer: Open the sign-in page and select Forgot password. Use the reset link sent to your account email. The link expires after 30 minutes; request a new one if it has expired.

title: Password reset email did not arrive
question: What if the password reset email does not arrive?
answer: Check spam and confirm you entered the email linked to the account. Wait a few minutes, then request one new reset link. If it still does not arrive, contact support without sharing your password.

title: Verification code rejected
question: Why is my sign-in verification code rejected?
answer: Use the newest verification code and check that your device clock is set automatically. Codes expire after five minutes. Request a fresh code if the current one is rejected.

title: Lost access to two-factor device
question: How can I sign in after losing my two-factor device?
answer: Use a saved recovery code if one is available. If you have no recovery code, contact support for identity review. Support will not ask for your password or a current verification code.

title: Change account email
question: How do I change the email address on my account?
answer: Open Account settings, choose Email, enter the new address, and confirm it using the link sent to that address. The old address remains active until confirmation finishes.

title: Sign out of other sessions
question: How do I sign out of other devices?
answer: In Account settings, open Security and choose Sign out of other sessions. Your current session stays signed in; other sessions must authenticate again.

title: App will not open
question: What should I do if the app will not open?
answer: Restart the app and check for an available update. If it still will not open, restart the device and contact support with the app version and device type. Do not send passwords or payment details.

title: Page stuck loading
question: How do I fix a page stuck loading?
answer: Check the network connection, refresh the page once, and try a private browser window. If only one page remains stuck, send support its page name and the approximate time of the problem.

title: Saved link shows 404
question: Why does a saved support link show a 404 page?
answer: A 404 means the saved address is unavailable. Return to the Help home page and search for the article title. If an in-app link still opens a 404, send that link to support.

title: Request rate limited with 429
question: What should I do after a 429 rate-limit error?
answer: A 429 means too many requests were sent in a short period. Pause and retry after the time in the Retry-After response, if present. Avoid repeatedly refreshing during the wait.

title: Service unavailable with 503
question: What should I do after a 503 service-unavailable error?
answer: A 503 indicates a temporary service problem. Wait a few minutes and retry once. If it continues, contact support with the time and page name; do not repeat payment actions blindly.

title: Upload failed
question: How can I fix a failed attachment upload?
answer: Confirm that the file is under 10 MB and uses PDF, PNG, or JPEG format. Retry on a stable connection. If the upload still fails, contact support with the file type and error message.

title: Notifications not arriving
question: Why are app notifications not arriving?
answer: Check notification permission in device settings and confirm notifications are enabled in Account settings. Restart the app after changing permissions. Email notification delivery may take a few minutes.

title: Offline changes not visible
question: Why are changes made offline not visible?
answer: Reconnect to the internet and reopen the affected page. Offline edits are not guaranteed to sync automatically; verify the saved result before repeating a write action.

title: Clear site cache
question: How do I clear an outdated site cache?
answer: Try a private browser window first. If it works there, clear cached files for this site and reload it. Do not clear saved passwords unless you intend to remove them.

title: Browser not supported
question: Which browser should I use if a page does not render?
answer: Update your browser to its latest stable version and disable extensions for one test. If the page still fails, contact support with the browser name, version, and page name.

title: Connection timed out
question: What should I do when a request times out?
answer: Check your connection and retry a read-only request once. For a payment or account change, check its current status before retrying because the original request may have completed.

title: Repeated network disconnects
question: How can I diagnose repeated network disconnects?
answer: Test a different network and restart the browser or app. If disconnects continue on multiple networks, contact support with the approximate times and device type.

title: Keyboard navigation
question: How do I navigate the support site with a keyboard?
answer: Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between controls, Enter or Space to activate a focused control, and Escape to close a dialog. Report any control that cannot be reached by keyboard.

title: Increase text size
question: How can I make support text larger?
answer: Use your browser zoom or device text-size setting. The support pages should reflow at larger sizes; report the page and zoom level if text becomes clipped.
